product_updates.title: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture Venezuela’s president
product_updates.content: President Trump reportedly asked for Grok's opinion before invading Venezuela and capturing Nicolás Maduro.

product_updates.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
product_updates.content: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.

product_updates.title: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,800 times before space data centers get off the ground
product_updates.content: Google launched its first advanced chip into orbit to pave the way for space data centers.

product_updates.title: OpenAI cuts ties with 3 safety researchers, WSJ reports
product_updates.content: OpenAI has parted ways with three safety researchers after an internal investigation found they mishandled sensitive company information, report says.

product_updates.title: Opus 5.5 loves to tell you ‘this matters’ (and other AI writing tells)
product_updates.content: Opus 5.5’s biggest tell is the word “dependable,” which pops up 23 times more often than in human samples.

product_updates.title: Amazon releases its own Jev clone as decision models flood the web
product_updates.content: Amazon Web Services' Strand Labs has released the latest Jevalike decision model, Strands Decider 2B.

product_updates.title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
product_updates.content: Shopify’s new Canvas site builder lets merchants create and customize their online stores by chatting with its AI agent Sidekick, while watching the changes happen in real time.

product_updates.title: Brian Chesky interview: AI agents need their own operating system
product_updates.content: Brian Chesky on making Airbnb agent-friendly, the state of consumer AI, and why the world needs an AI-native operating system.

product_updates.title: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.
product_updates.content: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.

product_updates.title: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses
product_updates.content: The glasses stem from the startup’s goal of making hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort, and stigma associated with traditional hearing aids.
